column_description: Unique identifier for each node type.
Name of the node type (e.g., vertex attribute, color, coordinate). always exactly one of 'vertex attribute', 'color', 'coordinate'. may be NULL.
Description of the node type. may be NULL.
Timestamp for when the node type was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp for the last update to the node type. may be NULL.
Category of the node type (e.g., basic, advanced). always exactly one of 'basic', 'advanced'. may be NULL.
